pr.title: Prevent Edge compatibility relaunch from breaking browser debugging
pr.author: Copilot

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript.Tests, Hosting.JavaScript, Hosting.JavaScrip... / Hosting.JavaScript (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: Both VerifyNodeAppWorks and VerifyNpmAppWorks fail with NodeAppFixture.InitializeAsync throwing TaskCanceledException from DcpExecutor.CreateRenderedResourcesAsync. This is a known recurring flaky pattern on windows-latest matching a prior cause (hosting-javascript-nodeappfixture-initializeasync-timeout), previously seen on unrelated PRs. The PR only changes VS Code extension files, unrelated to Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript tests.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: The 'standalone' Blazor browser debugger E2E test times out waiting for a pwa-msedge child debug session to attach. This exact error pattern (timeout waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root) matches a prior cause (vscode-extension-e2e-unrelated-logs-unavailable) that has recurred across 16+ prior occurrences on many unrelated PRs, jobs, and OSes, indicating a systemic environment/timing flakiness in the browser-debugger E2E scenario rather than a regression from this PR's changes.
